Camp Uzita's living history.verification: Part of Ebyabe's numbered "DeSoto Natl Mem" series documenting this exact memorial; the thatched-roof huts behind a wood-plank fence match the recreated Camp Uzita village the pick describes. No reenactors are shown, since the seasonal living-history programs are not always running, but the physical camp itself is the pick's clear subject. A candidate showing the camp's own "Camp Ucita" sign was found but not used because its Commons licence tag was an unverifiable self-declared public-domain claim rather than a clear CC licence.
